{
  "voter": "Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite",
  "round": 12,
  "audit_summary": "Site shifts correctly toward subfloor-first messaging but multiple fundamentals were left unfinished. Contractual SB-5 is violated on nearly every English page title, sitemap coverage is a single URL stub, structured data lacks required image fields, and operational caching/IaC pieces are still minimal.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "dimension": "technical_seo",
      "severity": "critical",
      "title": "Homepage title violates SB-5",
      "evidence": "§4.3 shows `<title>PLYCEM Non-Combustible Subfloor — Multifamily & Commercial USA</title>` on `/`.",
      "issue": "SB-5 prohibits placing “PLYCEM” in any `<title>` tag on the primary domain, yet the homepage title still leads with the Plycem mark.",
      "fix": "Edit `app/page.tsx` metadata title to remove the Plycem string (e.g., `Non-Combustible Subfloor for Multifamily & Commercial USA`) and redeploy.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": "SB-5"
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "dimension": "technical_seo",
      "severity": "critical",
      "title": "Product page titles still contain PLYCEM",
      "evidence": "§4.7 `generateMetadata` sets `title: `${product.name} — PLYCEM Fiber-Cement Panel`` for every `/products/:slug` route.",
      "issue": "All product detail titles insert “PLYCEM”, which directly conflicts with SB-5’s site-wide ban on the term inside `<title>` tags.",
      "fix": "Update `app/products/[slug]/page.tsx` metadata builder to use alternative phrasing (e.g., `${product.name} — Fiber-Cement Structural Panel`) and ensure no title includes “PLYCEM”.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": "SB-5"
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "dimension": "technical_seo",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Sitemap only lists the homepage",
      "evidence": "§4.12 `public/sitemap.xml` contains a single `<url>` entry for `/` and comments noting it is a stub.",
      "issue": "Crawlers cannot discover the nine product pages, resources, or Spanish routes via sitemap, and there are no `lastmod` or hreflang entries beyond the homepage.",
      "fix": "Implement `app/sitemap.ts` (or add `next-sitemap`) to enumerate all canonical routes with `lastmod`, hreflang alternates, and priority values, then remove the stub file.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "dimension": "onpage_seo",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Secondary pages fall back to generic title template",
      "evidence": "§4.5 root metadata defines the default template `%s | JARA International Inc.` but routes like `/contact`, `/service-areas`, `/pricing`, etc. do not override metadata (no per-page metadata files in §4.4 route map).",
      "issue": "Important supporting pages inherit the generic site tagline, missing intent-specific keywords and reducing click relevance for searches like “JARA contact” or “PLYCEM service areas”.",
      "fix": "Add `metadata` exports to each supporting page component (e.g., `app/contact/page.tsx`, `app/service-areas/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx`, and their `/es` counterparts) with descriptive titles and meta descriptions aligned to the page intent.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "dimension": "schema",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Product JSON-LD lacks required image field",
      "evidence": "§4.9 `productSchema` omits the `image` attribute entirely, yet Google’s Product rich results require at least one image URL.",
      "issue": "Without `image`, Google will not surface Product rich snippets and may ignore the entire Product schema block.",
      "fix": "Augment `productSchema` in `lib/jsonld.ts` to include `image: product.images` (or the hero image URL) for every product before emitting the JSON-LD.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "dimension": "ai_friendliness",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "llms.txt is outdated after catalog expansion",
      "evidence": "§4.13 notes the Products section in `public/llms.txt` still “lists 6 products — catalog currently has 9 products, not 6”.",
      "issue": "AI agents following the llms.txt guidance receive incomplete product coverage, breaking the “single source of truth” requirement noted in §4.0.",
      "fix": "Update `public/llms.txt` (and `llms-full.txt` if needed) so the Products section mirrors the current nine-product catalog, including the new deck modular, lap siding, and corrugated roof tile entries.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "dimension": "performance",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "HTML responses bypass Cloudflare edge cache",
      "evidence": "§4.2 curl outputs show `Cache-Control: s-maxage=31536000` but `CF-Cache-Status` is missing and `x-nextjs-cache: MISS`, while §4.1 reports median CPU 100 ms on the active deployment indicating server-side recomputation.",
      "issue": "Every page request is rendered at the worker level instead of being cached at the edge, driving up CPU time and slowing TTFB until Cloudflare manually purges on deploy.",
      "fix": "Use OpenNext’s Cloudflare cache integration (e.g., configure `defineCloudflareConfig({ cache: { cachingHeaders: true }})` or add custom Worker logic) to set `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=86400` on HTML responses and rely on the Cache API so CF returns `HIT` after the first request.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "dimension": "infra",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Custom domain routing is not codified in wrangler.toml",
      "evidence": "§4.16 shows the `[routes]` block commented out (`# { pattern = \"jarainternational.com\", custom_domain = true }`).",
      "issue": "Leaving domain bindings unmanaged in IaC risks drift and failed redeploys if the Cloudflare dashboard configuration changes or if a new environment is provisioned.",
      "fix": "Uncomment the routes array in `wrangler.toml` (and add `www.jarainternational.com`) so custom domains are provisioned automatically during deploys.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    }
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "Robust robots.txt explicitly whitelists major AI crawlers and references llms guidance (§4.11).",
    "Organization/WebSite/Product schema generation centralised in `lib/jsonld.ts`, keeping SB-4 and MadeToOrder compliance consistent (§4.9).",
    "Next.js font loading uses `next/font` with `display: swap`, aiding CLS (§4.5).",
    "AI-focused endpoint `/api/llm-context` exists and is cached for one hour, giving machines structured data (§4.17)."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "Need to confirm whether `/products?q=` actually supports on-page search to justify the WebSite SearchAction schema (§4.9).",
    "Cannot verify heading hierarchy (H1/H2) or image alt text quality without rendered markup beyond metadata snippets.",
    "Unclear what caused the 9 Cloudflare worker errors noted in §4.1; logs are needed to determine whether they’re user-facing."
  ]
}
